findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Independent by design. International in outlook." → 3 lines (6 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "04 INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCES" above "Digital projects & concepts."; "Hospitality / Boutique Retreat" above "AURA Sanctuary"; "Gastronomy / Culinary Atelier" above "KÔN Atelier"; "Architecture / Spatial Practice" above "MONOLITH Studio"; "Beauty & Commerce / Cellular Care" above "SŌMA Formulations"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "Dark", "/", "Light", "ES"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / AURA", "02 / KÔN", "03 / MONOLITH", "04 / SŌMA", "01 / Selected Work", "02 / Capabilities"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 69 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "// ZYRVAE", "/", "Independent Digital Studio", "BUENOS AIRES [34°36′S 58°22′W] // GLOBAL").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 4 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.75) 0%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.15) 50%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.3) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.75) 0%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.15) 50%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.3) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.75) 0%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.15) 50%, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.3) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 17 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hidden.lg:flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | article.lg:col-span-12.group → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 49 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.flex.flex-wrap 1216px | div.w-full.flex 315px | div.space-y-2.5.pt-3 315px | div.pt-6.sm:pt-7 1216px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 28 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 17 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (5 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 161 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (112px, 226px, 587px, 853px, 274px, 335px, 732px); the three most used hold only 42% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 3900px at 10336px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Digital, with intention.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.
